## Summary of changes

Describe what changed and why.

## How to test / verify

List the steps used to validate this change locally. Include sandbox ZATCA steps when the change affects signing, onboarding, compliance, reporting, clearance, renewal, or QR generation.

## Checklist

- [ ] Built locally with `npm run build`
- [ ] Formatting reviewed where relevant
- [ ] README or docs updated when behavior changed
- [ ] No secrets, certificates, private keys, or credentials were committed
- [ ] Tested against the ZATCA sandbox when the change affects API or signing behavior

## Reviewer notes

Call out the most important files, risks, or edge cases to review first.
